answer: Twelve strangers form a harbor crew bond. Each posts 100 tokens into a shared bond of 1,200, locked 120 days, and they run a cedar workboat between the harbor and an island. After every crossing a different member signs the boat log. The harbor master checks signatures against tide records twice a season, and one member caught with a second identity burns the whole bond. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 crews and 1,000,000 locked tokens. Like a fishing crew sharing one boat, a cheat drills a hole under his own feet, and the rest throw him overboard before water reaches their knees.
